name: uniform_bspline_ceres
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y cmake libeigen3-dev libboost-dev libceres-dev libgtest-dev libbenchmark-dev pybind11-dev python3-dev python3-pip python3-venv && git clone --depth 1 --branch remove_catkin_dep https://github.com/KIT-MRT/uniform_bspline.git /tmp/uniform_bspline && cmake -S /tmp/uniform_bspline -B /tmp/uniform_bspline/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && sudo cmake --install /tmp/uniform_bspline/build && rm -rf /tmp/uniform_bspline
